snippet.title: Paranoir - Release Trailer
snippet.description:
Download for free on itch.io: https://lopezr.itch.io/paranoir

Paranoir is an indie Visual Novel set in 1851 London.
You play as an annoyed grandson trying to recall the details of your Grandpa's comedic debut detective case.
